Level rule: the instrument gain is √2 times the game gain (1.4142), the make-up that keeps a panned part as loud as a centred one in the game; the studio sends every Undertone voice through a stereo panner (3.01 dB down at the centre), so it is the game's own level. Partner layer of Lead (octave up): the same notes on a sine, half the level, 2 ms late, panned opposite. Today a partner is a duplicated track, so an edit to Lead (octave up) does not follow it here.
